pages.author: Scenario briefing · fictional
pages.subject: If I hadn’t gone to Toronto
paragraphs: Fictional profile: took a practical course in Toronto; later used the skills on a community project; now leads small projects with more confidence. A collaborator was met during the course. No job offer or inevitable career outcome is claimed. Alternative timelines are hypotheses, not evidence.

pages.title: A turning point
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: In this story, what made the short course in Toronto a turning point?
lines.audioText: In this story, what made the short course in Toronto a turning point?
lines.translation: Nesta história, o que tornou o curso curto em Toronto um ponto de virada?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: The person took a chance on a practical course and now feels confident leading small projects
lines.audioText: The person took a chance on a practical course and now feels confident leading small projects.
lines.translation: A pessoa arriscou fazer um curso prático e hoje se sente confiante para liderar projetos pequenos

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: So if they hadn’t taken the course, they wouldn’t be doing that now?
lines.audioText: So if they hadn’t taken the course, they wouldn’t be doing that now?
lines.translation: Então, se não tivesse feito o curso, não estaria fazendo isso hoje?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: They might be less confident, but we can’t know that they’d never have learned another way
lines.audioText: They might be less confident, but we can’t know that they’d never have learned another way.
lines.translation: Talvez tivesse menos confiança, mas não sabemos se nunca teria aprendido de outra forma

questions.prompt: What present skill is linked to the course?
questions.answer: They now lead small projects with more confidence

pages.title: An unexpected consequence
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: That’s fair. What actually happened after the course?
lines.audioText: That’s fair. What actually happened after the course?
lines.translation: É justo. O que realmente aconteceu depois do curso?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: They used the new skills on a community project and met a future collaborator
lines.audioText: They used the new skills on a community project and met a future collaborator.
lines.translation: Usou as novas habilidades em um projeto comunitário e conheceu uma futura colaboradora

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Was meeting that person part of the original plan?
lines.audioText: Was meeting that person part of the original plan?
lines.translation: Conhecer essa pessoa fazia parte do plano original?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Not at all. That was an unexpected consequence, not a promised outcome
lines.audioText: Not at all. That was an unexpected consequence, not a promised outcome.
lines.translation: Não. Foi uma consequência inesperada, não um resultado prometido

questions.answer: No. It was an unexpected consequence

pages.title: One path, not the only path
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: What would be different now if that meeting hadn’t happened?
lines.audioText: What would be different now if that meeting hadn’t happened?
lines.translation: O que seria diferente hoje se aquele encontro não tivesse acontecido?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: The collaboration might not exist, although they could still have developed the skills
lines.audioText: The collaboration might not exist, although they could still have developed the skills.
lines.translation: A colaboração talvez não existisse, embora ainda pudesse ter desenvolvido as habilidades

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: So the experience matters, but there isn’t only one possible path
lines.audioText: So the experience matters, but there isn’t only one possible path.
lines.translation: Então a experiência importa, mas não existe só um caminho possível

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Exactly. I’d separate the facts from what we imagine about the alternative
lines.audioText: Exactly. I’d separate the facts from what we imagine about the alternative.
lines.translation: Exatamente. Eu separaria os fatos do que imaginamos sobre a alternativa

pages.title: The unexpected collaboration
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana. There’s one more detail about that short course. The unexpected benefit wasn’t a job offer. The person met someone who later invited them to help with a community project. They still collaborate now, and that work has made it easier to explain their skills to other people. If they hadn’t gone to Toronto, that particular collaboration might not exist today. But it would be too strong to say they’d have no opportunities at all. Could you explain the present consequence and then describe a plausible alternative, making clear which part is a fact and which part is only a possibility?
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana. There’s one more detail about that short course. The unexpected benefit wasn’t a job offer. The person met someone who later invited them to help with a community project.
